description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.t. 17.11.2025 to 23.11.2025
categorisation: This gazette notification is a "Customs Notification (General)" issued under the Customs Ordinance. It formally announces and sets the official rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. This falls squarely under the definition of a **Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5)**, as it pertains to the implementation of a regulatory framework (customs law), involves a statutory instrument, and establishes compliance requirements for financial transactions related to imports/exports. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized category like Land, Commercial, or Elections.
